name: IT Central Station (PeerSpot)

sources.title: Domain now serves PeerSpot (the IT Central Station rebrand) — live enterprise tech review platform with deep category taxonomy and comparisons; 'Samantha' voice AI agent for reviews promoted on homepage

conditions: Vendor listing on PeerSpot is possible but the platform is driven by enterprise peer reviews — a product gets a profile, then needs verified enterprise users to review it; review sourcing is the actual bottleneck
requirements: Enterprise-tech product fit — PeerSpot's taxonomy is cybersecurity, cloud, data, IT management, enterprise apps, networking, storage, comms, sales/marketing tech
Vendor product page on peerspot.com (itcentralstation.com serves the PeerSpot platform)
Reviews come from verified enterprise professionals — PeerSpot vets reviewer identity; fake/incentivized reviews are the thing the platform exists to prevent
Vendor programs exist to get reviews sourced/managed — commercial relationship accelerates coverage
preparation: An enterprise-grade B2B product with real deployable customers
A pool of enterprise users willing to write verified reviews
Vendor contact with PeerSpot to establish the product profile
workflow: Contact PeerSpot to get the product listed (vendor onboarding)
Seed verified customer reviews — organic or via PeerSpot's review-sourcing programs
The product page accrues reviews and appears in category rankings/comparisons
watchFor: itcentralstation.com is the legacy brand — current product is PeerSpot; the catalog domain still resolves to it
Enterprise-only taxonomy — a dev tool or consumer SaaS doesn't fit
Without reviews the product page is thin — the listing's value is proportional to verified-review volume
Vendor programs are commercial — 'organic' presence alone is slow
countsAsLive: The product has a PeerSpot page with verified reviews (reachable via itcentralstation.com URLs)
unknowns: Vendor onboarding cost/requirements — commercial terms not public
Whether itcentralstation.com will eventually hard-redirect to peerspot.com
